grammar.pattern: 不过 / 但 / 但是 / 而且 / 那 / 如果 / 虽然 / 只要
grammar.purpose: Choose the connective that matches the relation
grammar.explanation: 不过、但、但是 introduce contrast; 而且 adds another point; 那 introduces a response to the previous situation. 如果 makes a condition and 只要 makes it sufficient. 虽然 concedes a fact before the contrast. The same clauses cannot freely swap all these words: 开心 is conceded, 旁边上课 is a cause, and 换到外面 is a proposed response. Keep each clause’s relation explicit.

examples.zh: 想法不错，不过声音有点大。
examples.py: xiǎng fǎ bú cuò , bù guò shēng yīn yǒu diǎn dà .
examples.en: The idea is good, but the voice is a little loud.

examples.py: zhè lǐ ān jìng , ér qiě yǒu kōng wèi .
examples.en: It is quiet here and also has empty seats.

examples.zh: 如果影响上课，那就换到外面。
examples.py: rú guǒ yǐng xiǎng shàng kè , nà jiù huàn dào wài miàn .
examples.en: If it affects the class, then move outside.

commonMistakes.wrong: 声音大，而且我们需要小声。这里是在转折。
commonMistakes.right: 声音大，不过我们可以小声说。
commonMistakes.why: When contrasting a problem with a remedy, 不过 fits the stated relation.

grammar.pattern: 虽然 … 但是 / 可是 / 不过；转折复句
grammar.purpose: Concede a point while stating a limitation
grammar.explanation: 虽然开心，但是不能影响别人 concedes happiness and sets a boundary. In natural conversation the second marker may be omitted when the contrast is clear. 虽然…所以 does not express the intended contrast. A criticism of volume is not a rejection of the idea or person; preserve both propositions.

examples.zh: 虽然想法不错，但是要小声一点。
examples.py: suī rán xiǎng fǎ bú cuò , dàn shì yào xiǎo shēng yī diǎn .
examples.en: Although the idea is good, we should speak a little more quietly.

examples.zh: 虽然我有这个习惯，不过愿意改。
examples.py: suī rán wǒ yǒu zhè gè xí guàn , bù guò yuàn yì gǎi .
examples.en: Although I have this habit, I am willing to change it.

examples.zh: 活动很开心，可是门口不能放包。
examples.py: huó dòng hěn kāi xīn , kě shì mén kǒu bù néng fàng bāo .
examples.en: The activity is enjoyable, but bags cannot be put in the doorway.

commonMistakes.wrong: 虽然开心，所以不能影响别人。
commonMistakes.right: 虽然开心，但是不能影响别人。
commonMistakes.why: The intended relation is concession and contrast, not causation.

reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.

lines.zh: 今天我们在活动室商量周六去哪儿。我一高兴，说话就大声了。陈宇轻轻提醒我，旁边还在上课。
lines.py: jīn tiān wǒ men zài huó dòng shì shāng liáng zhōu liù qù nǎr . wǒ yī gāo xìng , shuō huà jiù dà shēng le . chén yǔ qīng qīng tí xǐng wǒ , páng biān hái zài shàng kè .
lines.en: Today we were deciding where to go on Saturday in the activity room. I got excited and spoke loudly. Chen Yu quietly reminded me there was a class next door.

lines.zh: 我把门关上，也小声了一点。小周刚来，想坐在我们旁边，可是我的包占了座位。我赶紧拿开，让她坐下。
lines.py: wǒ bǎ mén guān shang , yě xiǎo shēng le yī diǎn . xiǎo zhōu gāng lái , xiǎng zuò zài wǒ men páng biān , kě shì wǒ de bāo zhàn le zuò wèi . wǒ gǎn jǐn ná kāi , ràng tā zuò xià .
lines.en: I closed the door and lowered my voice. Xiao Zhou had just arrived and wanted to sit with us, but my bag was on the seat. I quickly moved it for her.

lines.zh: 我提议去河边，陈宇还没听完就问几点出发。我笑着让他等一下，先把要走的路讲完，再一起定时间。
lines.py: wǒ tí yì qù hé biān , chén yǔ hái méi tīng wán jiù wèn jǐ diǎn chū fā . wǒ xiào zhe ràng tā děng yī xià , xiān bǎ yào zǒu de lù jiǎng wán , zài yì qǐ dìng shí jiān .
lines.en: I suggested the riverside. Before I'd finished, Chen Yu asked when we'd leave. Laughing, I asked him to wait while I explained the route, then we'd decide the time together.

lines.zh: 我们最后约了三点在车站见。小周说这个时间不错，她上午还有事情，下午正好能够出来。
lines.py: wǒ men zuì hòu yuē le sān diǎn zài chē zhàn jiàn . xiǎo zhōu shuō zhè gè shí jiān bù cuò , tā shàng wǔ hái yǒu shì qíng , xià wǔ zhèng hǎo néng gòu chū lái .
lines.en: We agreed to meet at the stop at three. That suited Xiao Zhou: she was busy in the morning but could come out that afternoon.

lines.zh: 活动室的钟响了，我以为设备出了问题。陈宇说那是正常的报时声音，已经四点，该回家了。
lines.py: huó dòng shì de zhōng xiǎng le , wǒ yǐ wéi shè bèi chū le wèn tí . chén yǔ shuō nà shì zhèng cháng de bào shí shēng yīn , yǐ jīng sì diǎn , gāi huí jiā le .
lines.en: The activity-room clock chimed. I thought something was wrong with the equipment. Chen Yu said it was the normal chime: four o'clock, time to go home.

lines.zh: 出门前我又看了一眼椅子，包已经拿走了。陈宇说周六别把包忘在车站，我说不会，到时里面还要装水呢。
lines.py: chū mén qián wǒ yòu kàn le yī yǎn yǐ zi , bāo yǐ jīng ná zǒu le . chén yǔ shuō zhōu liù bié bǎ bāo wàng zài chē zhàn , wǒ shuō bù huì , dào shí lǐ miàn hái yào zhuāng shuǐ ne .
lines.en: Before leaving I checked the chair; I'd taken the bag. Chen Yu told me not to leave it at the stop on Saturday. I wouldn't, I said; I'd need it for the water.

extraReadings.title: A complaint, gently: words in context
extraReadings.blurb: Independent everyday examples; these are separate situations.
extraReadings.purpose: Understand each word in a different situation.

lines.zh: 虽然大家开心，也要小声一点。
lines.py: suī rán dà jiā kāi xīn , yě yào xiǎo shēng yī diǎn .
lines.en: Although everyone is happy, we should keep our voices a little lower.

lines.zh: 虽然下雨了，我们还是出门了。
lines.py: suī rán xià yǔ le , wǒ men hái shi chū mén le .
lines.en: We went out despite the rain.

lines.zh: 旁边有人上课，所以请小声说。
lines.py: páng biān yǒu rén shàng kè , suǒ yǐ qǐng xiǎo shēng shuō .
lines.en: Someone nearby is having class, so please speak quietly.

lines.zh: 今天很冷，所以我多带了一件衣服。
lines.py: jīn tiān hěn lěng , suǒ yǐ wǒ duō dài le yī jiàn yī fú .
lines.en: It's cold today, so I brought another layer.

lines.zh: 那我关上门，再小声说。
lines.py: nà wǒ guān shang mén , zài xiǎo shēng shuō .
lines.en: Then I will close the door and speak more quietly.

lines.zh: 那就明天再见吧。
lines.py: nà jiù míng tiān zài jiàn ba .
lines.en: Then let's meet tomorrow instead.

lines.zh: 让我把这句话说完，好吗？
lines.py: ràng wǒ bǎ zhè jù huà shuō wán , hǎo ma ?
lines.en: May I finish this sentence?

lines.zh: 让我看看你拍的照片。
lines.py: ràng wǒ kàn kàn nǐ pāi de zhào piān .
lines.en: Let me see the photo you took.

lines.zh: 包占了两个座位，请拿开一个。
lines.py: bāo zhàn le liǎng gè zuò wèi , qǐng ná kāi yī gè .
lines.en: The bags take up two seats; please clear one.

lines.zh: 这张桌子太大，占了半个房间。
lines.py: zhè zhāng zhuō zi tài dà , zhàn le bàn gè fáng jiān .
lines.en: This table is so big it takes up half the room.

lines.zh: 我站在门边，没有坐在座位上。
lines.py: wǒ zhàn zài mén biān , méi yǒu zuò zài zuò wèi shàng .
lines.en: I am standing by the door, not sitting in a seat.

lines.zh: 他站在车站旁边等我。
lines.py: tā zhàn zài chē zhàn páng biān děng wǒ .
lines.en: He's standing beside the stop, waiting for me.

lines.zh: 听到朋友叫我，我先站住。
lines.py: tīng dào péng you jiào wǒ , wǒ xiān zhàn zhù .
lines.en: When I hear my friend call, I stop first.

lines.zh: 前面有车，先站住别走。
lines.py: qián miàn yǒu chē , xiān zhàn zhù bié zǒu .
lines.en: There's a car ahead. Stop; don't move yet.

lines.zh: 声音太大，会影响旁边的人。
lines.py: shēng yīn tài dà , huì yǐng xiǎng páng biān de rén .
lines.en: An overly loud voice can affect the people nearby.

lines.zh: 昨晚没睡好，影响了今天的工作。
lines.py: zuó wǎn méi shuì hǎo , yǐng xiǎng le jīn tiān de gōng zuò .
lines.en: A poor night's sleep affected today's work.

lines.zh: 今天事情太多，我忘了回消息。
lines.py: jīn tiān shì qíng tài duō , wǒ wàng le huí xiāo xī .
lines.en: I had so much to do today that I forgot to reply.

lines.zh: 等这件事情做完，我就回家。
lines.py: děng zhè jiàn shì qíng zuò wán , wǒ jiù huí jiā .
lines.en: I'll go home when I've finished this task.

lines.zh: 新同学受到大家的欢迎。
lines.py: xīn tóng xué shòu dào dà jiā de huān yíng .
lines.en: Everyone welcomed the new classmate.

lines.zh: 这本书受到很多读者的欢迎。
lines.py: zhè běn shū shòu dào hěn duō dú zhě de huān yíng .
lines.en: This book has been welcomed by many readers.

lines.zh: 我重视你的意见，也想听完。
lines.py: wǒ zhòng shì nǐ de yì jiàn , yě xiǎng tīng wán .
lines.en: I value your opinion and want to hear it fully.

lines.zh: 她很重视这次比赛，每天都练习。
lines.py: tā hěn zhòng shì zhè cì bǐ sài , měi tiān dōu liàn xí .
lines.en: This competition matters to her; she practises every day.

lines.zh: 他们已经开始行动了。
lines.py: tā men yǐ jīng kāi shǐ xíng dòng le .
lines.en: They have already started taking action.

lines.zh: 救人行动已经结束。
lines.py: jiù rén xíng dòng yǐ jīng jié shù .
lines.en: The rescue operation has ended.

lines.zh: 这种行为很危险，别学。
lines.py: zhè zhǒng xíng wéi hěn wēi xiǎn , bié xué .
lines.en: That behaviour is dangerous. Don't copy it.

lines.zh: 他的行为让大家很感动。
lines.py: tā de xíng wéi ràng dà jiā hěn gǎn dòng .
lines.en: His actions moved everyone.

lines.zh: 改了时间以后，活动进行得很顺利。
lines.py: gǎi le shí jiān yǐ hòu , huó dòng jìn xíng de hěn shùn lì .
lines.en: After the time was changed, the activity went smoothly.

lines.zh: 今天一路顺利，很快就到家了。
lines.py: jīn tiān yī lù shùn lì , hěn kuài jiù dào jiā le .
lines.en: The trip went smoothly today. I got home quickly.

lines.zh: 设备正常，不是设备坏了。
lines.py: shè bèi zhèng cháng , bù shì shè bèi huài le .
lines.en: The equipment is working normally; it is not broken.

lines.zh: 手机现在能正常用了。
lines.py: shǒu jī xiàn zài néng zhèng cháng yòng le .
lines.en: The phone works normally now.

lines.zh: 这条路很安全，我们走这里吧。
lines.py: zhè tiáo lù hěn ān quán , wǒ men zǒu zhè lǐ ba .
lines.en: This road is safe. Let's go this way.

lines.zh: 到了家给我发消息，我想知道你安全到家。
lines.py: dào le jiā gěi wǒ fā xiāo xī , wǒ xiǎng zhī dào nǐ ān quán dào jiā .
lines.en: Message me when you get home. I'd like to know you've arrived safely.

lines.zh: 我有大声说话的习惯，但可以改。
lines.py: wǒ yǒu dà shēng shuō huà de xí guàn , dàn kě yǐ gǎi .
lines.en: I have a habit of speaking loudly, but I can change it.

lines.zh: 我习惯早上先喝一杯水。
lines.py: wǒ xí guàn zǎo shàng xiān hē yī bēi shuǐ .
lines.en: I'm used to having a glass of water first thing in the morning.

lines.zh: 不要打断，让她说完。
lines.py: bú yào dǎ duàn , ràng tā shuō wán .
lines.en: Do not interrupt; let her finish.

lines.zh: 不要忘了带钥匙。
lines.py: bú yào wàng le dài yào shi .
lines.en: Don't forget your keys.

lines.zh: 你的想法不错，声音可以小一点。
lines.py: nǐ de xiǎng fǎ bù cuò , shēng yīn kě yǐ xiǎo yī diǎn .
lines.en: Your idea is quite good; your voice could be a little lower.

lines.zh: 这家店的茶不错。
lines.py: zhè jiā diàn de chá bù cuò .
lines.en: The tea at this shop is good.

lines.zh: 这个办法挺好，我们试试。
lines.py: zhè gè bàn fǎ tǐng hǎo , wǒ men shì shì .
lines.en: This is a good idea. Let's try it.

lines.zh: 你今天看起来挺好。
lines.py: nǐ jīn tiān kàn qǐ lái tǐng hǎo .
lines.en: You look well today.

lines.zh: 声音影响上课，怎么办？
lines.py: shēng yīn yǐng xiǎng shàng kè , zěn me bàn ?
lines.en: The noise affects the class; what should we do?

lines.zh: 钥匙不见了，怎么办？
lines.py: yào shi bú jiàn le , zěn me bàn ?
lines.en: My keys are missing. What should I do?

lines.zh: 我们能够换到外面聊。
lines.py: wǒ men néng gòu huàn dào wài miàn liáo .
lines.en: We can move outside to chat.

lines.zh: 六点以前我能够做完。
lines.py: liù diǎn yǐ qián wǒ néng gòu zuò wán .
lines.en: I can finish before six.

audio.zh: 三点吧。到时候我发消息。
audio.py: sān diǎn ba . dào shí hou wǒ fā xiāo xī .

tasks.statement: The proposed meeting time is three.
tasks.why: The heard line explicitly states this fact.

audio.zh: 活动室的钟响了，我以为设备出了问题。陈宇说那是正常的报时声音，已经四点，该回家了。
audio.py: huó dòng shì de zhōng xiǎng le , wǒ yǐ wéi shè bèi chū le wèn tí . chén yǔ shuō nà shì zhèng cháng de bào shí shēng yīn , yǐ jīng sì diǎn , gāi huí jiā le .
audio.en: The activity-room clock chimed. I thought something was wrong with the equipment. Chen Yu said it was the normal chime: four o'clock, time to go home.

tasks.statement: The clock sound means the equipment is broken.
tasks.why: The heard line explicitly gives a different fact.

prompt.zh: 这个包是谁的？小周想坐这儿。
prompt.py: zhè gè bāo shì shéi de ? xiǎo zhōu xiǎng zuò zhèr .
prompt.en: Whose bag is this? Xiao Zhou wants to sit here.

tasks.why: This reply fits the immediate request.

prompt.py: xiān ràng wǒ shuō wán , xíng ma ?

notes:
AI-assisted draft; native review pending. GF2021 grammar families: 二30, 二65. Native check: connective relations, 虽然 marker omission, 受到重视 collocation, 合宜 in the written note, friendly noise complaint and figurative original scene. No validated behaviour score is claimed. Planned retrieval 二25 / 二59: 我对这个活动有兴趣。, 她跟我一样喜欢看书。, 生活不同，不等于态度不好。.
2026-10-07 parity editorial review: Targeted HSK 2 naturalness review: natural 点了炒鸡蛋和一盘青菜 replaces generic dish wording, with precise passage glosses and aligned English; restaurant choice with a previous twenty-minute wait versus ten minutes today; two red scarves with different shoes, blue layer packed; printing only pages two/three at two and handing them over at three, Saturday event at two; activity-room discussion with a normal four-o’clock chime and Saturday three meeting. Removed assessment, identity and consent lectures inside friendly speech. All existing word/task IDs preserved. First examples retained where suitable, specific awkward examples fixed; every word also has an independently authored second context. Abstract education, behaviour and action vocabulary stays in separate examples rather than forced conversation. False statements checked against their own audio. Native flags: 为 beneficiary register, 取得成绩/同意 versus 拿到, educational 教师/教育/教学/中小学/年级 terms, 求 playful plea, 满意/不满 and 好处/坏处, adjective 色 forms, 站住 request strength, formal 受到/行动/行为 and colloquial 挺好. Native review pending. Native review pending; no independent pronunciation or learner-mastery certification.
